reference.title: Tool reference
reference.intro: All 23 tools, with every parameter, default, constraint and example. The same interface is available through MCP and the CLI.
conventions: The examples are MCP argument objects. For a raw MCP `tools/call`, use the tool name as `name` and the object as `arguments`. Hosts may prefix tool names. The equivalent CLI calls below use `mcp-gmap-rs call TOOL --args JSON`.

Only top-level parameters have CLI flags. Pass nested objects and arrays as JSON. A bare boolean flag means `true`; `--flag false` sets `false`. Unknown properties are rejected. Inspect your installed release with `tools` or `schema TOOL`.

Google authentication and language are process configuration, not tool parameters. Exact route coordinates avoid address resolution; named locations may also require an API key for Geocoding. See [authentication](../guide/authentication) and [configuration](../guide/configuration).

Calls can incur Google charges. Composite and matrix results may contain per-item errors even when the tool succeeds. Preserve Google source links, review/photo authors and AI-summary disclosures. Examples illustrate inputs, not current coverage or results.

Types, required fields and schema bounds come from the executable's schema-derived reference. Defaults, result descriptions and cross-field restrictions are reviewed against the implementation. Google may impose additional coverage and quota limits.
